senses.zh: 寬容的；能容忍的；耐受的

examples.en: Our teacher is tolerant of mistakes when students are trying their best.
examples.zh: 學生盡力時，我們的老師對錯誤很寬容。

examples.en: People in this neighborhood are tolerant of different customs.
examples.zh: 這個社區的人對不同的習俗很包容。

examples.en: This plant is tolerant of both heat and dry soil.
examples.zh: 這種植物耐熱，也耐乾燥的土壤。

examples.en: The school will not tolerate cheating on exams.
examples.zh: 學校不會容許考試作弊。

examples.en: I can't tolerate the noise from the building site any longer.
examples.zh: 我再也無法忍受工地傳來的噪音了。

examples.en: Some people cannot tolerate spicy food very well.
examples.zh: 有些人不太能耐受辛辣的食物。

examples.en: We visited an ancient tomb during our trip to Egypt.
examples.zh: 我們到埃及旅行時參觀了一座古墓。

examples.en: The tomb was built more than two thousand years ago.
examples.zh: 這座墳墓是在兩千多年前建造的。

examples.en: Tourists were asked to be quiet inside the tomb.
examples.zh: 遊客被要求在墓室裡保持安靜。

examples.en: The tortoise moved slowly across the garden.
examples.zh: 那隻陸龜慢慢地爬過花園。

examples.en: A tortoise can live for more than a hundred years.
examples.zh: 陸龜可以活一百多年。

examples.en: My brother keeps a small tortoise as a pet.
examples.zh: 我弟弟養了一隻小陸龜當寵物。

examples.en: The flood was a great tragedy for the whole village.
examples.zh: 這場洪水對整個村莊來說是一大悲劇。

examples.en: We read a famous tragedy by Shakespeare in English class.
examples.zh: 我們在英文課讀了莎士比亞的一齣著名悲劇。

examples.en: It would be a tragedy if the old library were torn down.
examples.zh: 如果那間老圖書館被拆掉，那就太可惜了。

examples.en: The tragic news made everyone in the room fall silent.
examples.zh: 這則悲慘的消息讓房裡的每個人都沉默了。

examples.en: It was a tragic accident that could have been avoided.
examples.zh: 那是一場原本可以避免的不幸意外。

examples.en: The movie has a tragic ending, so bring some tissues.
examples.zh: 這部電影的結局很悲傷，所以要帶些衛生紙。

examples.en: I need to transfer some money to my mother's account.
examples.zh: 我需要轉一些錢到我媽媽的帳戶。

examples.en: You have to transfer to the red line at the next station.
examples.zh: 你必須在下一站轉乘紅線。

examples.en: My father was transferred to the Taichung office last month.
examples.zh: 我爸爸上個月被調到台中辦公室。

examples.en: The bank transfer will take about two working days.
examples.zh: 銀行轉帳大約需要兩個工作天。

examples.en: She asked for a transfer to a different class.
examples.zh: 她申請轉到另一個班級。

examples.en: This ticket allows one free transfer within ninety minutes.
examples.zh: 這張票允許在九十分鐘內免費轉乘一次。

examples.en: Heat can transform liquid water into steam in a boiler.
examples.zh: 熱能可以使鍋爐中的液態水變成水蒸氣。

examples.en: The new park will transform this empty lot into a green space.
examples.zh: 新公園會把這塊空地變成綠地。

examples.en: Online learning has transformed the way students study.
examples.zh: 線上學習已經改變了學生的讀書方式。

examples.en: Can you translate this sentence into Chinese for me?
examples.zh: 你可以幫我把這個句子翻成中文嗎？

examples.en: She translated the menu for the foreign tourists.
examples.zh: 她為外國遊客翻譯了菜單。

examples.en: Good ideas do not always translate into good results.
examples.zh: 好點子不一定會轉化成好成果。

examples.en: The translation of this poem is very close to the original.
examples.zh: 這首詩的譯文非常貼近原文。

examples.en: I read the English translation of the novel first.
examples.zh: 我先讀了這本小說的英文譯本。

examples.en: Translation is harder than many people think.
examples.zh: 翻譯比許多人想的還要困難。

examples.en: The translator helped us talk with the Japanese guests.
examples.zh: 譯者協助我們與日本客人交談。

examples.en: My aunt works as a translator for a publishing company.
examples.zh: 我阿姨在出版社擔任譯者。

examples.en: I use a translator app when I travel abroad.
examples.zh: 我出國旅行時會用翻譯應用程式。

senses.zh: 交通運輸；運輸工具；交通

examples.en: Public transportation in Taipei is cheap and convenient.
examples.zh: 台北的大眾運輸既便宜又方便。

examples.en: The city provides free transportation for senior citizens.
examples.zh: 這座城市為長者提供免費的交通服務。

examples.en: What kind of transportation do you take to school?
examples.zh: 你搭什麼交通工具上學？

examples.en: Her hands trembled as she opened the letter.
examples.zh: 她打開信時，雙手不停地顫抖。

examples.en: The little dog trembled during the thunderstorm.
examples.zh: 雷雨中，那隻小狗一直發抖。

examples.en: The windows trembled when the truck drove past.
examples.zh: 卡車駛過時，窗戶微微震動。

examples.en: The concert drew a tremendous crowd to the stadium.
examples.zh: 這場演唱會吸引了大批群眾到體育場。

examples.en: Thank you for your tremendous help with the project.
examples.zh: 謝謝你在這個專案上給予莫大的協助。

examples.en: There has been a tremendous change in our town.
examples.zh: 我們的小鎮出現了巨大的改變。

examples.en: The team's triumph in the final made the whole school proud.
examples.zh: 球隊在決賽中的勝利讓全校引以為傲。

examples.en: Finishing the marathon was a personal triumph for him.
examples.zh: 跑完馬拉松對他來說是個人的一大成就。

examples.en: The new bridge is a triumph of modern engineering.
examples.zh: 這座新橋是現代工程的一大成就。

examples.en: Our class triumphed over the other teams in the singing contest.
examples.zh: 我們班在歌唱比賽中擊敗了其他隊伍。

examples.en: She triumphed in the end after years of hard work.
examples.zh: 經過多年努力，她終於成功了。

examples.en: Good will always triumph over evil in this story.
examples.zh: 在這個故事裡，善良總是戰勝邪惡。

senses.zh: 麻煩的；令人煩惱的；棘手的

examples.en: This old computer is troublesome and keeps shutting down.
examples.zh: 這台舊電腦很麻煩，一直自動關機。

examples.en: The troublesome noise from upstairs kept me awake all night.
examples.zh: 樓上惹人厭的噪音讓我整晚睡不著。

examples.en: He found the form troublesome to fill out.
examples.zh: 他覺得這份表格填起來很麻煩。

examples.en: The little boy tumbled down the grassy hill.
examples.zh: 那個小男孩從長滿草的山丘上滾了下來。

examples.en: Stock prices tumbled after the bad news came out.
examples.zh: 壞消息一公布，股價就暴跌了。

examples.en: Be careful, or you will tumble off the chair.
examples.zh: 小心點，不然你會從椅子上跌下來。

examples.en: She took a bad tumble on the icy sidewalk.
examples.zh: 她在結冰的人行道上重重摔了一跤。

examples.en: The company's shares took a sharp tumble this week.
examples.zh: 這家公司的股價本週大幅下跌。

examples.en: The toddler had a small tumble but was not hurt.
examples.zh: 那個學步的幼兒跌了一跤，但沒有受傷。

examples.en: A small bird sat on a thin twig outside the window.
examples.zh: 一隻小鳥停在窗外的細枝上。

examples.en: We gathered dry twigs to start the campfire.
examples.zh: 我們撿了乾的細枝來生營火。

examples.en: The twig snapped when I stepped on it.
examples.zh: 我踩到那根細枝時，它啪地斷了。

senses.zh: 普遍的；全世界的；通用的

examples.en: Music is a universal language that everyone can enjoy.
examples.zh: 音樂是人人都能欣賞的世界共通語言。

examples.en: Smiling is a universal sign of friendliness.
examples.zh: 微笑是友善的普遍象徵。

examples.en: This charger has a universal plug that fits most countries.
examples.zh: 這個充電器有通用插頭，適用於大多數國家。

examples.en: The doctor urged him to get more rest.
examples.zh: 醫生力勸他多休息。

examples.en: Our teacher urges us to read at least one book a month.
examples.zh: 我們的老師敦促我們每個月至少讀一本書。

examples.en: The mayor urged everyone to save water during the dry season.
examples.zh: 市長呼籲大家在乾季時節約用水。

examples.en: I had a sudden urge to eat ice cream.
examples.zh: 我突然很想吃冰淇淋。

examples.en: She felt a strong urge to call her old friend.
examples.zh: 她強烈地想打電話給老朋友。

examples.en: He tried to resist the urge to check his phone.
examples.zh: 他努力克制想看手機的衝動。

examples.en: I have an urgent message for the manager.
examples.zh: 我有一則緊急訊息要給經理。

examples.en: The patient needs urgent medical care after the serious accident.
examples.zh: 這名病人在嚴重事故後需要緊急醫療照護。

examples.en: Please reply as soon as possible because the matter is urgent.
examples.zh: 這件事很急，請盡快回覆。

examples.en: This dictionary gives clear examples of word usage.
examples.zh: 這本字典對字詞用法提供了清楚的例子。

examples.en: The usage of electricity goes up during the summer.
examples.zh: 夏天的用電量會增加。

examples.en: Please read the instructions for proper usage before you start.
examples.zh: 開始前請先閱讀說明，了解正確的使用方式。

senses.zh: 徒勞的；自負的；愛慕虛榮的

examples.en: All our efforts to save the old tree were in vain.
examples.zh: 我們搶救那棵老樹的所有努力都白費了。

examples.en: He is so vain that he checks the mirror every few minutes.
examples.zh: 他很愛慕虛榮，每隔幾分鐘就照一次鏡子。

examples.en: She made a vain attempt to open the locked door.
examples.zh: 她徒勞地想打開那扇鎖住的門。

examples.en: A vast desert lies to the north of the city.
examples.zh: 城市北邊有一大片廣闊的沙漠。

examples.en: The library has a vast collection of books.
examples.zh: 這間圖書館有大量的藏書。

examples.en: Vast amounts of data are stored on this server.
examples.zh: 這台伺服器儲存了大量的資料。

examples.en: My cousin has been a vegetarian for five years.
examples.zh: 我表哥已經吃素五年了。

examples.en: The restaurant has a special menu for vegetarians.
examples.zh: 這家餐廳有為素食者設計的特別菜單。

examples.en: Are you a vegetarian, or do you eat fish?
examples.zh: 你是素食者，還是你也吃魚？

examples.en: We ordered a vegetarian pizza for lunch.
examples.zh: 我們午餐點了一份素食披薩。

examples.en: This cafeteria offers a vegetarian meal every day.
examples.zh: 這間自助餐廳每天都提供素食餐。

examples.en: She follows a vegetarian diet for health reasons.
examples.zh: 她基於健康因素採取素食飲食。

examples.en: A large vessel entered the harbor early this morning.
examples.zh: 一艘大船今天一早駛進港口。

examples.en: Pour the soup into a large vessel and let it cool.
examples.zh: 把湯倒進大容器裡放涼。

examples.en: The doctor said a blood vessel in his eye had burst.
examples.zh: 醫生說他眼睛裡有一條血管破裂了。

examples.en: Drivers who violate traffic rules may have to pay a fine.
examples.zh: 違反交通規則的駕駛可能得繳罰款。

examples.en: It is rude to violate someone's privacy by reading their messages.
examples.zh: 偷看別人的訊息是侵犯隱私的失禮行為。

examples.en: The company violated the contract by delivering late.
examples.zh: 這家公司延遲交貨，違反了合約。

examples.en: Parking here is a violation of the city rules.
examples.zh: 在這裡停車違反市府規定。

examples.en: He received a ticket for a traffic violation.
examples.zh: 他因交通違規而收到罰單。

examples.en: Copying someone else's work is a violation of school policy.
examples.zh: 抄襲別人的作品違反校規。

examples.en: Honesty is a virtue that everyone should have.
examples.zh: 誠實是每個人都該具備的美德。

examples.en: Patience is a great virtue when you teach young children.
examples.zh: 教導幼童時，耐心是一項很重要的美德。

examples.en: There is no virtue in waiting until the last minute.
examples.zh: 拖到最後一刻才動手並沒有什麼好處。

examples.en: The flu virus spreads easily in crowded places.
examples.zh: 流感病毒在擁擠的地方很容易傳播。

examples.en: Wash your hands often to avoid catching a virus.
examples.zh: 常洗手，以免感染病毒。

examples.en: A virus infected my computer and deleted some files.
examples.zh: 電腦病毒感染了我的電腦，還刪除了一些檔案。

examples.en: Pictures are a helpful visual aid for young learners.
examples.zh: 圖片對年幼的學習者來說是很有幫助的視覺輔助。

examples.en: She is studying visual arts at a university in Kaohsiung.
examples.zh: 她在高雄的一所大學主修視覺藝術。

examples.en: The doctor tested the visual ability of every student.
examples.zh: 醫生檢查了每位學生的視力。

senses.zh: 極重要的；必不可少的；生命的

examples.en: Water is vital for all living things.
examples.zh: 水對所有生物來說都是不可或缺的。

examples.en: Good communication is vital to a team's success.
examples.zh: 良好的溝通對團隊的成功至關重要。

examples.en: The nurse checked the patient's vital signs every hour.
examples.zh: 護理師每小時檢查一次病人的生命徵象。

examples.en: Joining the beach cleanup is voluntary, so nobody has to come.
examples.zh: 參加淨灘是自願的，所以沒有人一定要來。

examples.en: She does voluntary work at the animal shelter on weekends.
examples.zh: 她週末在動物收容所做志工。

examples.en: The company offers a voluntary health check for all employees.
examples.zh: 公司為所有員工提供自願參加的健康檢查。

examples.en: We need more volunteers to help at the school fair.
examples.zh: 我們需要更多志工來協助學校園遊會。

examples.en: The volunteers handed out free water to the runners.
examples.zh: 志工們發免費的水給跑者。

examples.en: My mother is a volunteer at the city library.
examples.zh: 我媽媽是市立圖書館的志工。

examples.en: Who wants to volunteer to clean the classroom?
examples.zh: 誰要自願打掃教室？

examples.en: She volunteered to carry the heavy boxes for her neighbor.
examples.zh: 她自願幫鄰居搬那些沉重的箱子。

examples.en: Tom volunteered his time to teach English at the center.
examples.zh: 湯姆自願花時間在中心教英文。

examples.en: The voyage from Keelung to Japan takes about two days.
examples.zh: 從基隆到日本的航程大約要兩天。

examples.en: They set out on a long voyage across the Pacific Ocean.
examples.zh: 他們展開了橫越太平洋的漫長航行。

examples.en: The captain wished everyone a safe voyage.
examples.zh: 船長祝大家一路平安。

examples.en: A loud noise wakened the baby in the middle of the night.
examples.zh: 一陣巨響在半夜把嬰兒吵醒了。

examples.en: She gently wakened her grandfather from his nap.
examples.zh: 她輕輕地把爺爺從午睡中叫醒。

examples.en: I usually waken before the alarm clock rings.
examples.zh: 我通常在鬧鐘響起之前就醒了。

examples.en: You can find the school schedule on our website.
examples.zh: 你可以在我們的網站上找到學校的課表。

examples.en: The company is building a new website for online shopping.
examples.zh: 這家公司正在建立一個新的網路購物網站。

examples.en: Please visit the website to sign up for the free class.
examples.zh: 請上網站報名這堂免費課程。

examples.en: The government is working to improve the welfare of senior citizens.
examples.zh: 政府正努力改善年長者的福祉。

examples.en: Teachers care about the health and welfare of their students.
examples.zh: 老師很關心學生的健康與福祉。

examples.en: The company supports employee welfare by offering paid holidays.
examples.zh: 這家公司提供有薪假，以增進員工福祉。

examples.en: He winked at me to show that he was joking.
examples.zh: 他對我眨眼，表示他在開玩笑。

examples.en: The baby winked at her mother and giggled.
examples.zh: 寶寶對媽媽眨了眨眼，咯咯地笑。

examples.en: Stars winked in the clear night sky.
examples.zh: 星星在晴朗的夜空中閃爍。

examples.en: She gave me a wink across the table.
examples.zh: 她隔著桌子對我眨了眨眼。

examples.en: I didn't sleep a wink because of the loud music.
examples.zh: 音樂太吵了，我一點都沒睡著。

examples.en: With a quick wink, he left the room.
examples.zh: 他迅速眨了一下眼，就離開了房間。

examples.en: The comedian is famous for his quick wit.
examples.zh: 這位喜劇演員以機智敏捷聞名。

examples.en: She answered the difficult question with great wit.
examples.zh: 她十分機智地回答了那個難題。

examples.en: My grandfather's wit made everyone at the dinner table laugh.
examples.zh: 我爺爺的風趣讓餐桌上的每個人都笑了。

examples.en: The witch in the story lived in a small house in the forest.
examples.zh: 故事裡的女巫住在森林裡的一間小屋。

examples.en: Many children dress up as a witch on Halloween.
examples.zh: 許多孩子在萬聖節時會打扮成女巫。

examples.en: In the fairy tale, a kind witch helped the lost girl.
examples.zh: 在童話故事裡，一位善良的女巫幫助了迷路的女孩。

examples.en: I need to withdraw some cash from the ATM.
examples.zh: 我需要從提款機領一些現金。

examples.en: She decided to withdraw from the speech contest.
examples.zh: 她決定退出演講比賽。

examples.en: The company withdrew its advertisement after many complaints.
examples.zh: 在收到許多客訴後，公司撤下了那則廣告。

examples.en: A witness saw the car hit the fence and called the police.
examples.zh: 一名目擊者看到汽車撞上圍籬，便報了警。

examples.en: The witness told the judge what happened that night.
examples.zh: 證人向法官說明了那晚發生的事。

examples.en: Two witnesses signed the wedding document at the end of the ceremony.
examples.zh: 儀式結束時，兩位見證人在結婚文件上簽了名。

examples.en: Many people witnessed the accident at the corner.
examples.zh: 許多人目睹了轉角的那場意外。

examples.en: We witnessed the first snowfall of the year.
examples.zh: 我們親眼見到了今年的第一場雪。

examples.en: This town has witnessed great changes in the last ten years.
examples.zh: 這個小鎮在過去十年見證了巨大的變化。

examples.en: I do a thirty-minute workout every morning before school.
examples.zh: 我每天早上上學前都做三十分鐘的運動。

examples.en: The coach planned a hard workout for the team.
examples.zh: 教練為球隊安排了一場高強度的訓練。

examples.en: After a long workout, he drank a bottle of water.
examples.zh: 經過長時間的運動後，他喝了一瓶水。

senses.zh: 殘骸；失事的船或車；身心俱疲的人

examples.en: The wreck of the old ship lies at the bottom of the sea.
examples.zh: 那艘老船的殘骸沉在海底。

examples.en: Divers explored the wreck near the island.
examples.zh: 潛水員探索了島嶼附近的沉船殘骸。

examples.en: After the long trip, I felt like a wreck.
examples.zh: 經過長途旅行後，我覺得自己累垮了。

examples.en: The heavy rain wrecked our picnic plans.
examples.zh: 大雨毀了我們的野餐計畫。

examples.en: A strong wind wrecked the small boat on the rocks.
examples.zh: 強風使那艘小船在岩石上失事。

examples.en: Don't let one bad grade wreck your confidence.
examples.zh: 別讓一次考不好就毀掉你的信心。

examples.en: The students yawned during the long speech.
examples.zh: 學生們在冗長的演講中打哈欠。

examples.en: My dog yawned and curled up on the sofa.
examples.zh: 我的狗打了個哈欠，然後蜷縮在沙發上。

examples.en: I tried not to yawn in front of the teacher.
examples.zh: 我努力不在老師面前打哈欠。

examples.en: She covered her mouth to hide a yawn.
examples.zh: 她摀住嘴巴掩飾一個哈欠。

examples.en: His big yawn showed that he was very tired.
examples.zh: 他打了個大哈欠，顯示他非常疲倦。

examples.en: A yawn spread quickly from one person to another in the room.
examples.zh: 哈欠在房間裡一個接一個地傳開了。

senses.zh: 年輕的；青春的；朝氣蓬勃的

examples.en: My grandmother has a youthful face and a warm smile.
examples.zh: 我奶奶有一張年輕的臉和溫暖的笑容。

examples.en: The team is full of youthful energy.
examples.zh: 這支隊伍充滿了青春活力。

examples.en: He still looks youthful even though he is almost sixty.
examples.zh: 雖然他快六十歲了，看起來仍然很年輕。

examples.en: The doctor helped the addict stop smoking.
examples.zh: 醫生協助那位上癮者戒菸。

examples.en: My brother is a game addict who plays until midnight.
examples.zh: 我哥哥是個遊戲迷，會玩到半夜。

examples.en: Some coffee addicts cannot start the day without a cup.
examples.zh: 有些咖啡成癮的人沒有喝上一杯就無法開始一天。

senses.zh: 含糊的；模稜兩可的；有歧義的

examples.en: The teacher said the question was ambiguous and rewrote it.
examples.zh: 老師說這個問題有歧義，便重新寫了一次。

examples.en: His answer was ambiguous, so I still did not know what he wanted.
examples.zh: 他的回答很含糊，所以我還是不知道他想要什麼。

examples.en: The sign is ambiguous and confuses many visitors.
examples.zh: 這個標示模稜兩可，讓許多訪客感到困惑。

examples.en: The museum displays arms and armor from several historical periods.
examples.zh: 博物館展示來自幾個歷史時期的武器與盔甲。

examples.en: The two countries signed an agreement to limit the sale of arms.
examples.zh: 兩國簽署協議，限制武器銷售。

examples.en: He sat in the chair and rested his arms on the table.
examples.zh: 他坐在椅子上，把手臂擱在桌上。
